notes.title: Patch 0.5.1 -- AI Update
notes.content:
Today, a patch goes live that will add the ability to play with AI-controlled players, enabling singleplayer games! 

Whether you need to fill out a lobby with additional players or test out new strategies in a solo game, the choice is yours; check out the full patch notes [url=http://www.playbattlesquares.com/patch-0-5-1-ai-update/]here.[/url]
